purpose: top by exemplar similarity, excluding rows already in the other chunks. The direct test of 'closer to the exemplars = better'; registered as its own biased method so the answer reads AGAINST the stratified chunks.

registration.NOTE: registered in tools/v7/build_manifest BEFORE the build. The fail-closed default would also have landed this train-side, but 'nobody registered it' and 'this is a biased train draw' are different facts.

render_defaults.maxiter: deep_center_finder._maxiter_for_fw(fw) — the cap every other corpus batch builder renders crops under

sampling_metaparameters.population: every recorded maneuver candidate of the crawl that the screen reached — pushed AND passed over; a candidate the 64x36 screen could not reach has no renderable crop
sampling_metaparameters.draw_order: uniform FIRST, then the two stratified chunks, then the exemplar mini-chunk — so the uniform leg's selection is never conditioned on a score
